text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 4.9% loss outpacing Bitcoin's 3.8%, signaling renewed weakness in both majors rather than selective selling. The Fear & Greed index at extreme fear (10) and deteriorating over the past week reflects sustained pessimism, while Bitcoin dominance holding at 57.8% suggests investors are rotating into alts rather than fleeing crypto entirely. Volume at $67B is moderate, indicating the selloff lacks panic-driven conviction but enough weight to establish a bearish short-term bias.
